name: Giant Wings Flapping.mp3
description:
I couldn't find any good giant wings flapping here, so I made my own and am now sharing them so nobody else has to! Screw paying for sounds! Made from a combination of pizza box lids, sheets, and a bit of sound design.

You don't even have to credit me because I mean...who even does that? And why? Who's gonna track down a foley artist from the credits of a show for a random sound? Just check out the Sonic Realms podcast if you like audiodramas and role playing games; there's nothing else like it. THAT'S something I would appreciate. But only if you feel like it.

Enjoy and use the hell outta the totally free sound!

name: Bird-wings

I needed to make the sound of some birds flying away for a film I did Foley for, and I had read somewhere that leather gloves being flapped sounded a lot like birds flying, so I tried it out and it worked rather well :-) I was pleased :-)

A rich collection of creative commons sound FX and music created by a filmmaker for filmmakers.

www.thefilmmakersarchive.com

name: 230429_2406_FR_DoveBuildingNest.mp3
description: Subtle warble and noise from a collared dove building her nest. (mp3 version) I made this recording during a spring afternoon, on a 4th floor balcony located in Nice city (south-east of France) while a dove was putting the finishing touch to her nest. The microphones were clipped on the side wall of the balcony, about 20cm under the nest. At the beginning of this long recording, one can hear the flapping wings of the dove coming to her nest, then she arranges it conscientiously during about 30 minutes, making some subtle noise and soft warbles. Then, finally, she decides to fly away. In the background, street ambience (some vehicles passing by, some birds and voices), airplanes flying over, light hum from the city and white noise from a fountain. Please note that this file is a MP3 version of the higher resolution (24 bits 48 kHz) recording available here : https://freesound.org/people/kevp888/sounds/686857/ Recorded in April 2023 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Micbooster Clippy Stereo EM272 microphones (Primo em272). Fade in/out and high pass filter at 30Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. (If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).

Carillon in the cloister of the Men’s Abbey, in Caen (binaural, please use headset for 3D effects). 
I made this recording in the cloister of l’Abbaye aux hommes (Men’s Abbey), located in the city of Caen (north-west of France). 
At #0:21, one can hear the pleasant tune of the carillon, immediately followed by the bell ringing 11 o’clock. Then, at #2:34, the bell will ring again. 
In the background, noises and voices from tourists visiting the place, flapping wings of pigeons and some other birds. 
Recorded in July 2024 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. 
(If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).

name: Black-capped chickadee - Mesange a tete noire.flac
description: A 30s sound clip of chickadees calling one another (or so it seems). You can hear the wing flapping of a bird nearby, as it approached me. Equipment used : Sony Minidisc (MZ NHF-800), binaural mics + preamp (www.visivoxtechnologies.com). Apparently, black-capped chickadees produce one of the most complex calls of the animal world! In fact, it is believed that they produce a warning call, then another call to identify themselves. For more info, google these keywords together : "chickadee complex call". Enjoy!
